title: BETWEEN (SQL) | InterSystems SQL Reference | InterSystems IRIS Data Platform 2026.1

examples.sql: SELECT Name,Age FROM Sample.Person WHERE Age BETWEEN 18 AND 21 ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name,Age FROM Sample.Person WHERE Age NOT BETWEEN 20 AND 55 ORDER BY Age
SELECT Name,Home_State,Home_City FROM Sample.Person WHERE Home_State BETWEEN Name AND Home_City ORDER BY Home_State
SELECT Name,Home_State FROM Sample.Person WHERE Home_State BETWEEN 'MA' AND 'Ma' ORDER BY Home_State
SELECT Name,Home_State FROM Sample.Person WHERE %SQLSTRING(Home_State) BETWEEN %SQLSTRING('MA') AND %SQLSTRING('Ma') ORDER BY Home_State
SELECT P.Name AS PersonName,E.Name AS EmpName FROM Sample.Person AS P INNER JOIN Sample.Employee AS E ON P.Name BETWEEN 'an' AND 'ch' AND P.Name=E.Name
SELECT Name FROM Sample.Person WHERE %STRING(Name) BETWEEN %SQLSTRING('OA') AND %SQLSTRING('OZ') ORDER BY Name
